description: Spend one of the signed-in person's diamonds on a one-to-one hour with Ben, at an open hour from my_bookings (pass its start exactly as listed, and name the hour by its label, never by a weekday you work out). The diamond is held at once and spent when Ben's calendar confirms, usually within a minute; if the hour is not booked it comes back. The answer's booking has its own label. Before the hour starts the person can move it with move_booking, or cancel it with cancel_booking and get the diamond back.

start.description: The start of an open hour exactly as my_bookings lists it, e.g. "2026-09-17T13:30:00.000+02:00".

timeZone.description: The person's time zone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Defaults to Berlin.

topic.description: What the person wants to work on in the hour, in a sentence or two.

name: book_hour_with_ben
